name_reason: Name follows the global convention exactly: data_ prefix (game global) + fd2_battle_ domain (battle core pathfind state) + descriptor path_output_buffer_ptr that reflects both role (path output buffer) and data type (_ptr = pointer). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own address 0x60073 or any other address). All claims verified against live Ghidra.
purpose: Holds the caller-supplied path-output-buffer base pointer for the destination pathfinder; the path-recording helpers write the resulting path (landed x/y or per-level direction sequence) into this buffer.
logic_summary: Written once at entry of fd2_pathfind_to_destination (0x4E1CE, full 32-bit store from the output-buffer argument); the plain flood-fill orchestrator never sets it. Read back as a (uint8 *) by two recorders: fd2_pathfind_record_destination_xy (0x4E3BB) stores the landed (x, y) at [0]/[1] on a mode-2 destination commit, and fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path (0x4E431) copies the recursion direction stack (one byte per level) into successive buffer bytes for best_path_length steps. Single scalar pointer, not a table.
datatype: uint32 (32-bit pointer; base address of a uint8 path-output buffer)
element_semantics: A single 32-bit pointer value. The pointed-to buffer holds either the landed destination (x, y) in bytes [0]/[1] (record_destination_xy mode-2 path) or a sequence of direction codes (3=right, 1=left, 0=down, 2=up), one byte per recursion level, written by check_destination_save_path.
notes: Live Ghidra cross-check: memory at 0x60073 = all zeros (BSS, write-before-read). Xrefs to 0x60073 = 1 WRITE (fd2_pathfind_to_destination @ 0x4E1CE) + 2 READ (fd2_pathfind_record_destination_xy @ 0x4E3BB, fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path @ 0x4E431) -- exactly matches the src comment. WRITE-xref present so is_const=false. Ghidra data plate was NULL (undocumented); created a concise plate via run_script_inline setComment(PLATE_COMMENT) and saved program (verified read-back, content matches).
